title: God ild you
html_source:
Internal narrative.

God reward you – said by Touchstone in As You Like it.

Touchstone is a complex role in the play. He is complete in terms of being the court jester therefore providing many laughs but outside of court his wit leaves no one untouched even though, Touchstone himself, remains an underdeveloped character.
